name: info-card
description: A live spend card above the prompt (cost, tokens, context, 5-hour limit, cache health, task) plus /ledger for spend by tool and prompt-cache detail.

color.title: Card color
color.description: Border and text color of the card.

showTotal.title: Show total cost
showTotal.description: Session cost so far (API-equivalent, not what a subscription charges).

showLastRun.title: Show last-run cost
showLastRun.description: What the most recent prompt cost.

showContext.title: Show context fill
showContext.description: How full the context window is, so you know when to /compact or /clear.

showLimit.title: Show 5-hour limit
showLimit.description: Percent of your 5-hour usage window used (subscriptions only; hidden otherwise).

showDuration.title: Show last-run time
showDuration.description: How long the most recent prompt took.

showTask.title: Show current task
showTask.description: Second line with the task being worked on.

aiTitles.title: AI task titles
aiTitles.description: Name each task with a small Haiku call (uses a little extra usage per prompt). Off: the task is the start of your prompt.

warnContextPercent.title: Context warning at %
warnContextPercent.description: Turn the context figure red once it reaches this percent. 0 turns the warning off.

showCache.title: Show cache health
showCache.description: Prompt-cache hit rate of the last response, or 'cold' once you have been idle past the cache lifetime. Details in /ledger.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after a response. 5 by default; use 60 if your plan uses the 1-hour cache.

cacheNudge.title: Idle cache nudge
cacheNudge.description: In the background, show a short notice shortly before the prompt cache expires, so you can send a prompt to keep it warm. Off until you switch it on. Needs a restart or /reload-plugins to start or stop.

nudgeLeadSeconds.title: Nudge lead time (seconds)
nudgeLeadSeconds.description: How long before the cache expires the notice appears.
